Source: [`R/classes.R`](https://codeberg.org/usrbinr/ti/src/branch/main/R/classes.R)
:::

<p><code>category</code> holds the cumulative cut-points used by <code><a href="abc.qmd">abc()</a></code> to bucket group
members. Assigning <code>category_names</code> derives one letter per cut-point from
<code>category_values</code>, so the default three cut-points become <code>a</code>, <code>b</code> and <code>c</code>.
</p>

## Usage

```r
category(category_values = c(0.7, 0.96, 1), category_names = NULL)
```

## Arguments

<dl class="qrtdown-arguments">
<dt id="arg-category-values"><code>category_values</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-category-values"></a></dt>
<dd><p>Numeric cumulative cut-points, all <code style="white-space: pre;">⁠&lt;= 1⁠</code>. Defaults to
<code>c(0.7, 0.96, 1)</code>.</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-category-names"><code>category_names</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-category-names"></a></dt>
<dd><p>Bucket labels; derived from the length of
<code>category_values</code> on assignment.</p></dd>
</dl>

## Value

<p>A <code>category</code> S7 object.
</p>
